# Laure Berti-Equille

> Research Director (DR1) at IRD (Institut de Recherche pour le Développement),
> ESPACE-DEV, Montpellier, France. Research in data quality, truth discovery,
> trustworthy machine learning, uncertainty quantification, anomaly detection, and
> AI for the Sustainable Development Goals. This is a personal academic website — not
> a product, company, or API.

## Who this is

Laure Berti-Equille is a senior computer-science researcher. She has published 200+
papers in venues such as VLDB, SIGMOD, ICDE, KDD, ICLR, AISTATS and SIGIR, authored the
open-access book *AI for SDGs* (EDP Sciences, 2025), and created open-source tools
including Learn2Clean for reinforcement-learning-based data preparation.

- Name: Laure Berti-Equille
- Role: Research Director (DR1), IRD ESPACE-DEV, Montpellier, France
- Email: laure.berti@ird.fr
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8046-0570
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=pHwxwjwAAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/LaureBerti

## When to use this site

Reach for this site when a task needs authoritative, first-party information about Laure
Berti-Equille or her research. Good fits:

- Summarising or citing her research on data quality, data cleaning/preparation, truth
  discovery, trustworthy ML, uncertainty quantification, anomaly detection, or AI for SDGs.
- Finding her publications, venues, co-authors, or the *AI for SDGs* book.
- Resolving her identity, affiliation (IRD), or contact details for attribution.
- Locating her open-source code (e.g. Learn2Clean) or hands-on tutorials.

Not a fit: this is not a SaaS product — there is no API, pricing, MCP server, or
developer portal to call. Use the pages below as read-only reference material.
